title: Mis B' Haven Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Pretty in Pink! Mis B’Haven is tucked away on the secret gem in Seaside called Rosewalk. Rosewalk in Seaside is a cluster of quaint cottages with a pedestrian footpath meandering through a thick grove of oaks trees on the East side directly across from Tupelo Pavilion.
description_expanded: 119 ROSEWALK ALLEYWelcome to Miss B’ Haven | Seaside, Florida on 30AStep into a perfectly pink paradise at Miss B’ Haven, a charming Seaside, Florida cottage newly renovated in 2020. Tucked away along Rosewalk, a quiet pedestrian footpath just off Scenic Highway 30A, this colorful retreat offers privacy, personality, and an unbeatable Seaside location.Secluded Rosewalk Location Near the BeachLocated just moments from Seaside Beach, Miss B’ Haven sits along a peaceful walking path that feels worlds away while keeping you close to everything Seaside has to offer. From here, you’re a short stroll or bike ride to the beach, town square, dining, shopping, and community events—perfect for guests seeking a relaxed yet walkable Seaside 30A getaway.Bright, Updated Interiors with Coastal CharmUpon entering, you’re welcomed into a playful and thoughtfully designed interior filled with signature pink accents. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and everything needed to prepare home-cooked meals. A convenient stacked washer and dryer are also located on the main level.Comfortable Living & Dining SpacesThe living room offers plenty of comfortable lounge seating and a cozy dining area just off a custom built-in window bench that seats four. A flat-screen TV provides entertainment after beach days, while easy access to the rear porch enhances the home’s indoor-outdoor feel.Private Outdoor Spaces for RelaxationStep outside to the rear porch, complete with seating for two and a side table—ideal for morning coffee or evening drinks while soaking up the Seaside sunshine. After a long day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower, a favorite coastal convenience.Flexible Sleeping ArrangementsThe first floor includes two bedrooms—a double bedroom and a twin bedroom—along with a full bathroom featuring a shower/tub combination shared throughout the cottage. Upstairs, the open loft offers a king bed and access to a private balcony with two chairs overlooking Seaside’s picturesque streets, creating a quiet retreat to unwind.A Colorful & Cozy Seaside EscapeWith its cheerful design, thoughtful updates, and secluded-yet-central location, Miss B’ Haven is the perfect choice for couples, small families, or friends looking for a unique and welcoming Seaside, Florida vacation rental. Bright, charming, and full of personality—this cottage is a joyful way to experience life on 30A.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES732 square feet of charming coastal living, located directly across from the beachPrivate Seaside residential beach access: Tupelo PavilionBeach proximity: Approximately a 1-minute walk (266 feet) to accessOutdoor convenience: Enclosed outdoor showerSeaside amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote includes: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority)Guest services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered a vehicle and count toward parking limits; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; exceptions for medical or special circumstances require an approved permitNo pets permittedSTR23-001870
